name: Remote Players
summary: Host or join over the network: connecting clients become possessed players.
description: Wires the engine's transport to the gameplay layer. A client that connects is spawned, possessed and added to the scoreboard; its input reaches the server through the same actions a local player uses; and remote pawns interpolate so they move smoothly at the twenty hertz send rate. Listen server, dedicated server or client, chosen on one component.
nextSteps: Add a NetSession component to an actor in the start scene and set its Mode.
Use NetworkGameMode instead of GameMode, or subclass it: NetSession warns when you have not.
Add a NetTransform to any actor whose position other machines need to see.
